shrtft1.note: SAE J1979 PIDs 06-09: (A-128)*100/128 = -100 .. +99.22 %; a railed trim reads at these limits (T-AUD-24a, amends T-W-6). Rail values are a sensor_fault signal consumed by COMLab trim-evidence scoring.

longft1.note: SAE J1979 PIDs 06-09: (A-128)*100/128 = -100 .. +99.22 %; a railed trim reads at these limits (T-AUD-24a, amends T-W-6).

shrtft2.note: Only validated when number_of_banks == 2. Must be null when number_of_banks == 1. SAE J1979 PIDs 06-09: (A-128)*100/128 = -100 .. +99.22 %; a railed trim reads at these limits (T-AUD-24a, amends T-W-6).

longft2.note: Only validated when number_of_banks == 2. Must be null when number_of_banks == 1. SAE J1979 PIDs 06-09: (A-128)*100/128 = -100 .. +99.22 %; a railed trim reads at these limits (T-AUD-24a, amends T-W-6).

control_module_voltage_v.note: Supply voltage at the PCM pins per OBDLab_KG_Wiki.md §3.1 / ecu-diagnosis/09.

bank_2_null_contract.rule: shrtft2 and longft2 must be null (not 0.0) when number_of_banks == 1. Emitting 0.0 for absent bank fields is a SEMANTIC_CONTRACT violation.
